rules: Scenarios are not forecasts and are stored separately from observed data.
Modelled arrivals = assumed arriving boats x assumed average people per arriving boat.
Average occupancy is not capacity; no utilisation, departure-success or interception rate is used.
Scenario values must be visually distinct from observed values without relying on colour alone.

assumptions.rationale: Latest 12 months published (July 2025-June 2026). A rolling year avoids treating 2026 (January-June only) as a full year.
REDUCTION and CONTINUATION hold occupancy at the baseline so that only the boat count differs. No evidence is used to predict occupancy.
Illustrative halving of arriving boats. Not tied to any policy, agreement or evidence of effect; chosen only to show a clearly lower case.
The highest calendar-year count of arriving boats observed 2018-2025. Using an observed maximum bounds the scenario by recorded experience.
The highest monthly average among months with at least 10 boats, applied to a whole year. A single-month value sustained for 12 months has never been observed.

release_note: Release subset: crossing scenarios only. Filtered from the full build; re-running build_scenarios.py requires the after-arrival data not included in this release.
